title: Deleted emails disappear - not in 'deleted mail' folder
creator: kevin2
content: When I deleted an email, it used to be moved to the 'deleted mail' folder, so I could always retrieve it if necessary. After the latest update this is no longer happening and the emails just disappear. How do I get this function back?
